subject: doxycycline
correct: BASHH 2020: ceftriaxone 1 g IM single dose + doxycycline 100 mg twice daily for 10–14 days
note: Not unsafe: 14 days is inside the BASHH range. But pages disagree. 'For 14 days' appears in tools/management/urethritis-male.html (x3), urethritis-male-print.html (x3), summaries/urethritis-male.html, tools/algorithms/scrotal-pain.html (which says '14 days standardised here'), one-page/scrotal-pain.html, assets/sca-addons-1.js + assets/sca-data/c/dysuria-sti.json. '10–14 days' appears in testicular-lump.html, one-page/testicular-lump.html, testicular-pain.html. OWNER QUESTION: standardise on '10–14 days (BASHH 2020)' everywhere, or keep 14 days and label it 'standardised from the BASHH 10–14-day range' on every page? Note that the urethritis-male pages and dysuria-sti attribute '14 days' directly to BASHH 2020, which is slightly inaccurate.

subject: doxycycline
correct: Periostat is doxycycline 20 mg twice daily; 40 mg once daily is the modified-release product (Efracea)

fixes.new: (e.g. 40 mg modified-release once daily, or the older 20 mg twice-daily Periostat regimen)

note: A minor factual error. The page names Periostat but gives the 40 mg modified-release once-daily dose. The total daily dose is the same, so the risk is low.
